intent.proves: Every email (not a template) has a recipient provider on itself or on its campaign folder.

bindings.reason: Handler not reserved: needs one call per subject (iterate ids from the list tool) and a client-side predicate. Predicate: providerTypeName empty.

bindings.query: SELECT CAST(e.EmailId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' ' + ISNULL(e.EmailName, N'') FROM EmailMarketingEmail e LEFT JOIN EmailMarketingTopFolder tf ON tf.TopFolderId = e.EmailTopFolderId WHERE ISNULL(e.EmailIsTemplate, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(DATALENGTH(e.EmailRecipientProviderConfiguration), 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(DATALENGTH(tf.TopFolderRecipientProviderConfiguration), 0) = 0
